why: Both analyses land on the key's hedgehog of consumer-electronics superstores measured by profit per region, but Analysis 2 adds the replicable playbook and national rollout discipline, ties the loss year to earlier sprawl, and pushes the CEO to commit to one format in writing. Analysis 1 is slightly better on decline risk, since it flags a new-format or category leap and regional share loss being explained away, and it is more careful about the missing profit data, but it hedges more on the format commitment.
